name: Marina Ferrari
bio: Marina Ferrari is a French centrist politician (Mouvement Démocrate, MoDem) born on 10 October 1973 in Aix-les-Bains (Savoie). Since the reshuffle in PM Sébastien Lecornu's government, she has served as Ministre des Sports, de la Jeunesse et de la Vie associative (Minister of Sports, Youth and Community Life), a post she first received in October 2025 and held through the February 2026 reshuffle. A deputy for Savoie's 1st constituency (Aix-les-Bains) since the 2022 legislative elections, she built her career as an administrative and HR executive, notably at the Chambéry-based digital start-up Lunabee Studio (2013-2022), and as a long-standing local elected official in Aix-les-Bains and the Savoie department. She presides over the MoDem's Savoie federation. Earlier in the current legislature she served as Secrétaire d'État chargée du Numérique (Secretary of State for Digital Affairs, February-September 2024) under PM Gabriel Attal, where she steered the SREN law on securing and regulating the digital space, and then as Ministre déléguée chargée de l'Économie du tourisme (September-December 2024) under PM Michel Barnier.
